summary: Backend-only iteration 5. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_noc.py with 11 new tests covering the 3 new features (Telegram settings, CSV camera import, per-camera 7-day uptime) plus regression. All 30/30 pytest cases pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: process_alerts_and_history swallows *all* exceptions when sending Telegram — good for resilience but consider structured logging so ops can spot broken tokens.

GET /api/settings returns the raw telegram_bot_token in addition to the masked variant; consider stripping the raw token from the GET response and returning only the masked version to prevent leakage via browser devtools.
SettingsInput.alert_threshold_minutes lacks a lower-bound validation (Field(ge=0)); a negative value would send alerts every refresh.
/api/cameras/import does not enforce uniqueness on (ip) — repeated imports create duplicate camera rows. Consider unique index on ip or dedupe by ip.
server.py has grown past ~410 lines with dense one-liners; splitting into routers/settings.py, routers/cameras.py, services/telegram.py would improve maintainability.
test_credentials: admin: test-admin-noc@example.com / TestAdmin123!  operator: test-operator-noc@example.com / TestOperator123!
seed_data_creation: Tests use TEST_ prefixed cameras (TEST_IMP_CAM1, TEST_IMP_CAM2, TEST_IMP_OK) and clean them up. db.settings is toggled during Telegram tests and disabled at the end of the bogus-token test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints (regression + new) are green. Test fixtures reuse existing test-admin/test-operator; if DB is dropped, admin_client will run POST /api/setup to recreate. Telegram tests validate 400 responses only — no real bot is contacted. camera-uptime test relies on POST /api/cameras/refresh writing today's row into db.camera_daily.
